network_settings.Description: Ingress settings for this service. Will apply to all versions.

ingress_traffic_allowed.Description: The ingress settings for version or service. Default value: "INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_UNSPECIFIED" Possible values: ["INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_UNSPECIFIED", "INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_ALL", "INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_INTERNAL_ONLY", "INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_INTERNAL_AND_LB"]

service.Description: The name of the service these settings apply to.
